Aurora

Xanadu

Aurora

Xanadu · photonics · DEMONSTRATED (Jan 2025) · 12 physical qubits · access: lab-only
architecture: פוטוניקה של משתנה רציף — GKP · Open on the map

Register profile — the machine's variant of its architecture

qubit type: GKP grid states in optical modes + squeezed vacuum
gate mechanism: Gaussian beamsplitters/squeezers + homodyne measurement with feed-forward; measurement-based
connectivity: time-domain-multiplexed CV cluster state; 86.4 billion modes entangled across chips over 2 hours of continuous operation
control: electro-optic modulators + real-time feed-forward at the 1 MHz clock
control placement: room-temp electro-optic
readout: homodyne (quadrature) detection with a shared local-oscillator phase reference; PNR detection heralds GKP states
codes: gkp-cluster-state
flags: detection only, loss dominated

Technologies by layer — the machine's cell per layer

1 נושא הקיוביט
אופן של אור סחוט (CV) · primary ▣ Fig. 2 (sources chips); Fig. 1 (GBS cells); Methods: Sources array ✅
squeezed vacuum from 24 SiN source chips: 84 squeezers in 42 GBS cells, feeding GKP state generation (Jan 2025)
2 קידוד
קידוד רשת GKP · primary ▣ Fig. 1 (architecture layout: GBS → refinery breeding) ✅
GKP grid states in optical modes; effective on-chip GKP squeezing 0.62 dB vs ~10 dB FT requirement
3 מנגנון השער
שערים גאוסיים CV + פעולות לא-גאוסיות בסיוע GKP · primary ▣ Fig. 3c,d (adaptive homodyne basis with feed-forward); Fig. 1 (QPU) ✅
Gaussian beamsplitters/squeezers + homodyne measurement with feed-forward; measurement-based on a CV cluster state
4 קישוריות והובלה
מיתוג / ניתוב פוטוני (אלקטרו-אופטי, הזנה קדימה) · primary ▣ Fig. 3a,b (12-mode macronode cluster, 86.4 billion modes) ✅
time-domain-multiplexed CV cluster state; 86.4 billion modes entangled across chips over 2 h continuous operation; switch loss 0.19 dB/MZI
5 בקרה
הנעה אלקטרו-אופטית + אלקטרוניקת הזנה קדימה (טמפרטורת החדר) · primary ▣ Fig. 2 (four-rack system modules); Extended Data Fig. 1 (hardware block diagram) ✅
room-temp electro-optic modulators + real-time feed-forward at the 1 MHz clock; four server racks
6 קריאה
גילוי קוודרטורה הומודיני (CV) · primary ▣ Fig. 2 (QPU homodyne detection); Methods: QPU array ✅
homodyne (quadrature) detection with a shared local-oscillator phase reference — the computational primitive of the CV machine
גילוי פוטון בודד (SNSPD / TES) · alternate ▣ Fig. 2 (cryogenic PNR array); Methods: PNR detection system ✅
PNR detection used only to herald GKP states; not the readout coordinate of the CV machine
7 קוד
שרשור בוזוני (חזרה-חתול, LDPC-חתול, GKP+qLDPC) · primary ▣ Fig. 3c,d (decoder-driven repetition-code checks); §Experiment ✅
gkp-cluster-state: foliated d=2 repetition code on a GKP CV cluster, real-time decoded — detection only, no Λ, no distance scan (Jan 2025)
8 מפענח
MWPM / Sparse Blossom (+התאמה מתואמת) · primary ▣ Fig. 3c,d; Fig. 2 (real-time decoder feedback) ✅
real-time, in-loop decoding at the 1 MHz clock (<1 µs per cycle), d=2 — the only in-loop decoder in photonics
Relay-BP ל-qLDPC (FPGA) · alternate ▨ 🔎
roadmap only: decoder for the GKP ⊗ qLDPC code layer; not demonstrated
9 חיבור בין-מודולי
קישורי סיב בין מודולים פוטוניים · primary ▣ Fig. 2 (fibre cabling and delay modules across racks) ✅
inter-rack fibre, 13 km of fibre interconnect across 35 chips; facet coupling 0.085 dB/facet
10 ייצור
בית יציקה למעגלים פוטוניים משולבים (SiN, BTO, TFLN, SNSPD על 300 mm) · primary ▤ Methods: Sources array; Refinery array; QPU array ✅
35 chips: 24 SiN source chips + 6 TFLN refinery chips + 5 Si-photonic QPU chips; SiN and TFLN photonic foundry, packaging in-house
